verdict.rationale: AMD ships an official CLI, xrt-smi, for monitoring/managing the NPU on Ryzen AI systems, which qualifies as an 'official CLI' tied to the AI hardware stack, and GAIA/Lemonade provide agent/LLM tooling though not explicitly documented as CLI-driven. Missing for 10: explicit CLI documentation for GAIA or Lemonade SDK (agentic workflows), broader CLI command reference/examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of CLI usage.
